title: Inject a clock into pricing
summary: Replace an ambient time read inside a pricing rule with an injected instant so time-based discounts stay deterministic.
objectives: Move an ambient clock dependency to an explicit input.
Decide time-based rules from a supplied UTC instant.
Handle weekend and time-of-day boundaries without guessing.
Keep pricing deterministic and testable across dates.
constraints: Use the supplied now value; never read the ambient clock.
Treat now as UTC for both the hour and the day of week.
WEEKEND10 applies on Saturday or Sunday when the base price is at least 3000 cents.
EARLYBIRD applies before 10:00 UTC and never makes the price negative.
Trim and upper-case the coupon before matching.
A base price of zero or less returns 0.
Unknown coupons return the base price unchanged.

examples.explanation: The weekend discount is 10% of the base price.
The early-bird rule applies before 10:00 UTC.
Exactly 10:00 UTC is no longer early.
